parameters.description:
Send a notification to your own Slack destination by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

`msg-to-slack` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`). On the Apprise channels the gateway composes an Apprise `slack://` URL from the credentials in your stored secrets and delivers the notification via apprise.unitysvc.dev, so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Four channels are available: the free `apprise` channel uses your own stored credentials; the `apprise-plus` channel binds extra per-enrollment destinations via enrollment parameters; the `gateway` and `gateway-plus` channels skip Apprise, transform the envelope into a native Slack incoming-webhook `{text}` payload, and deliver it straight to hooks.slack.com. The `gateway` channel is free, while `gateway-plus` is $0.001 per message for extra per-enrollment Slack destinations.
parameters.gateway_body_template: {"text":{* _escape_json((_body.title or "")..(((_body.title or "")~="" and (_body.body or "")~="") and "\n" or "")..(_body.body or "")) *}}
parameters.gateway_plus_price_description: $0.001 per message — extra per-enrollment Slack destinations, direct
parameters.gateway_price_description: Free — direct to your Slack incoming webhook (no Apprise)
